title: LMCache/LMCache Nightly 2026-08-05 · CUDA 12.9
event_hint: LMCache publishes a 2026-08-05 nightly CUDA 12.9 wheel built from the dev branch
problem: The nightly release provides an installable pre-release LMCache build for CUDA 12.9 users who need the latest dev-branch changes before a stable release.
mechanism: The GitHub release publishes nightly CUDA 12.9 wheels built from dev on 2026-08-05 and directs users to install lmcache with uv pip --pre, the PyTorch cu129 extra index, and the nightly-cu129 expanded-assets link.

evidence.claim: The nightly CUDA 12.9 wheels were built from dev on 2026-08-05.
The installation command uses uv pip install lmcache --pre with the cu129 extra index and nightly-cu129 expanded assets.

evaluation_context: This is an upstream LMCache GitHub nightly release page. The available text documents packaging and installation only; it contains no runtime benchmark, workload, hardware, latency, throughput, or cache-transfer measurements.
limitations: This is a nightly dev build and may be unstable or incompatible with released APIs. The page does not describe the included code changes, dependency matrix, or performance impact; those require inspecting the repository or package separately.
project_relevance: The nightly wheel may enable testing the latest LMCache changes on CUDA 12.9 infrastructure, but this release alone provides no evidence of improvements to KV-cache transfer or state-aware networking.
source_notes: The upstream GitHub nightly release URL was fetched and its release body was available despite page-loading warnings.
No functional or performance claims beyond the packaging information were inferred.
